entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: A human planeswalker from Dominaria with a draconic form, one of the Nine Titans, who becomes an evil force after his sister's death and is killed by Urza.

entities.name: Tymolin Loneglade
entities.description: Tev's sister, an accomplished fighter enchanted with eternal youth, whose death transforms Tev.

entities.name: Kaylen
entities.description: A dwarf lover of Tymolin who fell in battle in 170 AR.

entities.name: Oliver Farrel
entities.description: An Icatian priest who had an affair with Tymolin, attacked Tev, and stabbed Tymolin to death.

entities.name: Sianna
entities.description: A Farrelite champion who wore a powerful cloak.

entities.name: Farrelites
entities.description: Followers of Oliver Farrel who attacked Tev and Tymolin.

entities.name: Vaylesh
entities.description: A leader of the Order of the Ebon Hand who captured Tymolin to lure Farrel into a trap.

entities.name: Order of the Ebon Hand
entities.description: A group that captured Tymolin and was incinerated by Tev.

entities.name: Loren
entities.description: An elven master-scout under attack by the druid Morgan and thallids whom Tev helped.

entities.name: Morgan
entities.description: A druid who fought Loren with thallids.

entities.name: Nine Titans
entities.description: A group of nine planeswalkers led by Urza in the defense of Dominaria.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: The leader of the Nine Titans who kills Szat.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane from which Szat comes.

entities.name: Sarpadia
entities.description: A continent where Tev and Tymolin lived and which Szat destroyed.

entities.name: Havenwood
entities.description: The place where Tev lived alone and underwent his transformation.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Szat fought at the Summit of the Null Moon.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: An evil planeswalker who with Szat patronized Lim-Dul.

entities.name: Lim-Dul
entities.description: A necromancer patronized by Szat and Leshrac in his war against Kjeldor.

entities.name: Jaeuhl Carthalion
entities.description: A character who defeated Szat when he tried to intensify the Ice Age.

entities.name: Kenan Sahrmal
entities.description: A character who defeated Szat in the War for Shandalar.

entities.name: Darigaaz
entities.description: A dragon whom Szat convinced to free the Primeval Dragons.

entities.name: Daria
entities.description: A Titan killed by Szat.

entities.name: Kristina of the Woods
entities.description: A Titan killed by Szat.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The plane devastated by soul bombs fueled by Szat's life energy.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war in which Tev and Tymolin were caught up.

events.summary: Tev and Tymolin are caught up in the Brothers' War with disastrous results, leaving Tev guilt-ridden and exiled from society in Sarpadia.
events.quote: Tev was left guilt-ridden, and eventually the two returned to Sarpadia where Tev chose to exile himself from society.

events.summary: Kaylen falls in battle when an orc stabs him from behind during an attack on the Dwarven empire.
events.quote: Kaylen fell in battle when he was stabbed from behind by an orc.

events.summary: Tev refuses Tymolin's plea to intervene against the forces of chaos.
events.quote: Tev continued his lack of intrusion, refusing to either stop the orcs and goblins or help the dwarves.

events.summary: Oliver Farrel and the Farrelites attack Tev and Tymolin; Tev disenchants Sianna's cloak and Tymolin is separated from him.
events.quote: Oliver Farrel and his Farrelites attacked Tev and Tymolin.

events.summary: Tev's planeswalker spark ignites and his appearance turns draconic as he declares himself the Doom of All Fools; he incinerates thallids attacking Loren.
events.quote: As his Planeswalker spark ignited, his grip on humanity began to slip

events.summary: Tymolin is captured by Vaylesh and the Ebon Hand and stabbed to death by Farrel.
events.quote: which backfired when Farrel stabbed Tymolin to death.

events.summary: Sensing his sister's death, Tev fully transforms into a serpentine dragon form and incinerates the Ebon Hand encampment, killing Sianna, Farrel and Vaylesh.
events.quote: Tev incinerated everyone present, including Sianna, Oliver Farrel, and Vaylesh.

events.summary: Tev renames himself Tevesh Szat and summons the orc-goblin army onto Montford with a Planar Gate, then begins destroying the empires of Sarpadia.
events.quote: His first action was to use a Planar Gate to summon the orc–goblin army onto Montford .

events.summary: Szat manipulates the battle between Freyalise and Jason Carthalion so that Storgard is damaged, and patronizes Lim-Dul with Leshrac.
events.quote: Szat and another evil planeswalker, Leshrac , acted as patrons to the necromancer Lim-Dûl during his war against Kjeldor .

events.summary: Szat fights Freyalise at the Summit of the Null Moon, tries to intensify the Ice Age, and is defeated by Jaeuhl Carthalion and later by Kenan Sahrmal on Shandalar.
events.quote: where he was defeated again, this time by Kenan Sahrmal .

events.summary: Urza recruits Szat for the Nine Titans, but Szat betrays them, frees the Primeval Dragons through Darigaaz and kills Daria and Kristina.
events.quote: However, Szat betrayed the Titans, convinced Darigaaz to free the Primeval Dragons , and killed Daria and Kristina of the Woods .

events.summary: Urza reveals he foresaw the betrayal and uses Szat's life energy to fuel the soul bombs that devastate Phyrexia, killing him.
events.quote: Fueling the bombs was the end of Szat.
